finding: VIRGIL runs the seed and the move in an agent shell (DEC-03, DEC-09), but BR-076 keeps git's prompts for the seed 'because a person runs it', and no rule sets prompts, a time limit, or a retry bound for the move; a stale lease restarts the move with no limit. A move that waits on a credential prompt for a new origin can be killed between the marker and the push. Apply the no-prompt mode and the 30-second limit of BR-076 to every git call of the seed and the move, bound the restarts of the move as BR-072 bounds a claim, and add the move to QS-20 or a sibling scenario.
why_this_severity: The nearest scenario, QS-20, has priority 2, so importance is medium; whether the agent shell hangs or fails on a prompt depends on the credential setup, which nobody has checked, so exposure is uncertain. A hang does not by itself hand out an ID twice; ATAM-0014 covers that consequence.
